DEVICE_BATTERY_POWER.description: Issues concerning rapid battery drain, device overheating, charging cable failure, wireless charging, or battery health degradation.
DEVICE_BATTERY_POWER.auto_handle_criteria: Software-level battery optimization, standard diagnostic advice, Low Power Mode guidelines, iOS battery health check.
DEVICE_BATTERY_POWER.escalation_criteria: Physical battery swelling, burning smell, charging port scorched, rapid 100% to 0% shutdown despite service warning.

OS_SOFTWARE_UPDATE.description: Bugs, app crashes, freezing, boot loops, update installation errors across iOS, iPadOS, macOS, or watchOS.
OS_SOFTWARE_UPDATE.auto_handle_criteria: Post-update minor UI glitches, app force close troubleshooting, cache clearing, standard force-restart guidelines.
OS_SOFTWARE_UPDATE.escalation_criteria: Device stuck in continuous boot-loop (white Apple logo), bricked after update, DFU recovery mode failure, critical OS crash causing total device lock.

APPLE_ID_SECURITY.description: Account lockouts, 2-Factor Authentication (2FA) verification, forgotten credentials, phishing attempts, unauthorized sign-ins.
APPLE_ID_SECURITY.auto_handle_criteria: Standard password reset link (iforgot.apple.com), general 2FA setup guidance.
APPLE_ID_SECURITY.escalation_criteria: Account takeover suspected, recovery key lost, unauthorized device added, phishing link clicked with credential leakage, device Activation Lock bypass requests.

HARDWARE_PHYSICAL_DAMAGE.description: Cracked screen, broken camera lens, water/liquid ingress, damaged speaker, button malfunction, frame bent.
HARDWARE_PHYSICAL_DAMAGE.auto_handle_criteria: Guidance to schedule Genius Bar or check AppleCare status only.
HARDWARE_PHYSICAL_DAMAGE.escalation_criteria: Any physical defect, water submersion, shattered display, physical speaker/mic hardware failure requiring technician inspection.

SUBSCRIPTION_BILLING.description: Unrecognized credit card charges, recurring App Store subscriptions, refund requests for apps/in-app purchases, family sharing payment issues.
SUBSCRIPTION_BILLING.auto_handle_criteria: Guiding customer to reportaproblem.apple.com for self-service refund, explaining subscription cancellation in Settings.
SUBSCRIPTION_BILLING.escalation_criteria: Disputed fraudulent charges over , repeated billing after cancellation, account billed for family member without authorization, refund rejected wrongfully.

CONNECTIVITY_ACCESSORIES.description: Wi-Fi dropouts, Bluetooth pairing failure with AirPods, Apple Watch sync issues, CarPlay disconnection.
CONNECTIVITY_ACCESSORIES.auto_handle_criteria: Network settings reset, AirPods unpair/re-pair steps, Bluetooth toggle, Wi-Fi DNS troubleshooting.
CONNECTIVITY_ACCESSORIES.escalation_criteria: AirPods firmware flash failure, complete hardware failure of Wi-Fi/Bluetooth modem (greyed out toggle), warranty replacement required.
